name: Drake Style (Style)
body:
You possess the ability to attack from the air, just as a drake.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Acrobatics rank 1.

Benefit: As a full round action, whenever you are adjacent to a solid object that is one size smaller than you or larger, you can make a DC 10 Acrobatics check. If this is successful, you can jump up to your land or flight speed above the ground (use your Acrobatics check to determine the height of your jump), although this movement must be in a straight line and you do not take any falling damage while falling using this feat. During this movement, you can move through other creature’s spaces and make an attack against one creature in your path with your unarmed strike; this attack is treated as being made with two hands for the purpose of the Power Attack feat. If your Acrobatics check exceeds a creature’s AC, that creature cannot make an attack of opportunity against you during this movement.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
